name: Commands that keep failing mid-turn get a grunt in its face, never a finish
case: The agent's commands fail one after another, twenty seconds apart, while its turn goes on. The first two are only bonks in the work stream, and Boop's brain hears nothing of them. The third is a line of its own: commands keep failing, and they hit Boop in the face. Boop reacts small, in its face: annoyed or determined, a grunt, a word or a swear at the run, but never a finish's failure animation, since the turn isn't over. The fourth, a run that goes on, may get another small reaction or none.
why: app/BoopKit/Core/TranscriptView.swift: the failure ladder's third and fourth rungs wake the brain (wakingRungs); app/BoopKit/Outputs/ReactOutput.swift: the failure animation is for a turn that finished failed; characters/boop/steering/mood/calm.md: a failure gets an annoyed face
